source_en: Home from school on Lenina Street.
Home to Mom with a shiny stone.
Getting my lost toy back.
Off my tram depot night shift.
Picking up my son from kindergarten.
Driving home. Car's by the gate.
Hello. My mom said I have to show you this paper.
I found a shiny stone in the dirt. Want to see?
Thank you. I'm going to see my mom now.
Am I in trouble? I don't think I broke anything.
I'll be very quiet. I've been practicing.
I didn't do anything wrong... I was just standing here...
It's getting dark... can someone... tell my mom?
Where are you coming from?
School on Lenina Street. Lots of empty desks today.
School on Pushkin Street. It's always very quiet there.
Nowhere. I've always been here. Haven't I always been here?
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Loud noises hurt my ears. Holding still helps.
No. I love loud noises. The louder the better!
My skin feels like it belongs to someone bigger.
Your hat is very big. Does it fall over your eyes?
Is it always this loud? The city is thinking very hard.
Show me the stone.
No. It's warmer now. It hums when I sleep.
What stone? I don't pick things up. Mom says it's dirty.
The stone's not in my pocket anymore. It's inside. It's warm in here.
